post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I performed well in my assassin role, utilizing stealth and strategy to achieve success. However, I could improve by being more proactive in sabotaging missions and less reactive to other players' actions.

player_observations.Bob: Bob, playing as the good character, seemed relatively weak, often being targeted by the evil team and failing to significantly contribute to my success. His predictability made him an easy target.
player_observations.Diana: Diana, another good character, demonstrated a strong but somewhat naive playstyle, often taking unnecessary risks and failing to adapt to the situation, making her a relatively easy kill for me.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's role as the evil character was well-executed, often providing crucial assistance to the team and working effectively together with me to achieve mission objectives, making a strong team dynamic.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's performance as Merlin revealed her skillful manipulation of game events, often creating situations that favored the evil team, making our mission successes all the more achievable.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I performed reasonably well as a good character, successfully completing missions when I had the right information, but ultimately fell short in critical moments due to incorrect role identification, which led to mission failures. I could improve by being more observant of player behavior and questioning them appropriately. My leadership roles also highlighted the need for more decisive action and timely decision-making.

player_observations.Eve: Eve played her role perfectly as Merlin, providing crucial information and guidance to the team. Her subtle questioning and ability to remain inconspicuous helped us achieve mission success.
player_observations.Diana: Diana displayed solid leadership and teamwork skills, working effectively alongside me to complete our missions. However, her inability to influence the outcome during critical moments when I was not present was noticed.
player_observations.Alice: Alice's portrayal as the Assassin was convincing, as her behavior often raised suspicions. Nevertheless, her inconsistent actions and occasional hints of loyalty towards other players made it difficult to pinpoint her true role until the final reveal.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's actions as the Minion were unremarkable and failed to draw attention, making it challenging to identify his involvement until the game's end. His influence often contributed to mission failures, showcasing the impact of an opposing Minion.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I successfully completed my role of evil by manipulating the mission outcomes, especially by voting against innocent leaders. My ability to stay under the radar and not being suspected helped me in the long run. However, I was almost exposed in Mission 3.

player_observations.Eve: Eve played an excellent Merlin, leading two successful missions and not getting caught, but her last-minute replacement with Bob did lead to her downfall.
player_observations.Bob: Bob played cautiously and was very loyal to Eve, but his innocence was revealed in the end due to Eve's mistake.
player_observations.Diana: Diana was too trusting and did not adequately investigate Bob and her leaders, which ultimately led to the downfall of our team.
player_observations.Alice: Alice played an exceptional Assassin, eliminating Eve and leading to our victory, but her impulsive voting against Charlie in Mission 4 led to our downfall.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I did well in maintaining secrecy and contributed to the success of mission 1 and 3. However, I also contributed to the failure of mission 5 by not trusting Alice enough to vote her out. Improving my voting strategy could be a point of improvement.

player_observations.Alice: Alice seemed very secretive and cautious in her actions which made it difficult to determine her true role until the reveal.
player_observations.Bob: Bob's playstyle seemed quite straightforward and trusting, which led to him being a target for me to investigate in later missions.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie effectively played his role of evil without revealing himself, often choosing actions that benefited the evil team without arousing suspicion.
player_observations.Eve: Eve, as Merlin, seemed to be aware of the majority of the player roles. Her actions in mission 1 seemed designed to give the team a winning chance without revealing too much about her own identity.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I did well in terms of identifying my teammates' good intentions as I managed to successfully complete missions 1 and 3. However, I could improve by paying closer attention to the players' voting patterns in order to make more informed decisions about whose roles to trust. Additionally, I might have reacted more defensively in mission 5 to try to salvage the outcome.

player_observations.Bob: Bob is a very cautious player who only makes decisions when absolutely necessary, which makes him hard to trust, but it also means that he's likely to be telling the truth when he does make decisions. He played the role of the good servant well, but could potentially be more proactive in helping the group.
player_observations.Diana: Diana took a very straightforward approach to the game, always making clear decisions and voting in favor of the group. While this made it easier to trust her, she also didn't contribute much to our discussions, which left me questioning her motivations at times.
player_observations.Alice: Alice played the role of the assassin very skillfully, managing to remain in the shadows and only striking when it was least expected. Their ability to remain quiet and non-descript made them an excellent assassin, but it also made me suspect them at times. I wish I had paid more attention to their behavior earlier in the game to see if I could have prevented the negative outcome in mission 4.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie took a clever approach to the game by pretending to be a good player and only voting with the group. However, their true intentions were eventually revealed through their voting patterns, and I should have seen through their deception earlier. If I had, I believe I could have made a difference in the outcome of the game.
